name: Using Los Angeles County Pre-Approved ADU Plans for Additions

mainEntity.name: Can an ADU additions contractor in Los Angeles County work with the County’s pre-approved ADU plans if I want to modify them or attach them to my existing house?
mainEntity.text: Can an ADU additions contractor in Los Angeles County work with the County’s pre-approved ADU plans if I want to modify them or attach them to my existing house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Los Angeles County offers pre‑approved ADU standard plans to speed up permitting, but they come with strict limitations that surprise many homeowners considering an addition. These plans are intended for stand‑alone units and must be built exactly as approved, aside from rotating or mirroring the layout. You cannot change room sizes, exterior style, window locations, or interior walls and still treat it as a pre‑approved plan. If your goal is an attached ADU or an addition that integrates with your existing house, those County standard plans will not apply because they do not account for your home’s structure, fire separation, or shared systems. An ADU additions contractor can certainly study these pre‑approved designs as inspiration, but any modification converts the project into a custom design that goes through the full plan review process. This means you will need site‑specific architectural and structural drawings, energy calculations, and all required engineering. When interviewing contractors, ask whether they have successfully used County standard plans, and have them explain clearly when those plans are appropriate versus when a custom attached design is mandatory. Understanding this early helps you choose the right design path and set realistic expectations for cost and permitting time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Los Angeles County’s pre‑approved ADU standard plans must be used as designed, with only orientation and mirroring allowed. An ADU additions contractor cannot modify these plans or directly attach them to your house as an addition; any changes require new custom plans reviewed and permitted like a standard project.
